problems.reason: Both sentences state that Trilophosuchus had a short, high snout and an arboreal lifestyle.
Sentence 17 says fossils date to the Miocene (~20 Ma), while sentence 19 limits the fossil range to the Early–Middle Miocene, excluding the Oligocene range mentioned in sentence 18.
Sentence 18 extends the known range into the Oligocene (27.3–11.63 Ma), but sentence 19 states the range is only from the Early to Middle Miocene.
The sentence describes the Ringtail Site environment rather than characteristics of Trilophosuchus itself.
